assertions.assertion: The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229)
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was denied
The denial was under Reason Code CO-197
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered

The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia, occurring against a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The diagnosis codes I47.1 and I25.10 are associated with the patient's condition
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The appeal must be submitted within ninety days of the notice
